## Summary

Describe the change and the reason for it.

## Security boundary

- [ ] Model output cannot grant permissions or override a decision.
- [ ] Denials and failures do not call protected handlers.
- [ ] Audit events avoid raw secrets and tool arguments.
- [ ] Limitations and unsupported cases are documented.

## Validation

- [ ] Automated tests added or updated.
- [ ] Full test suite run; skipped tests listed.
- [ ] Benchmark run if scenarios, policy behavior, or metrics changed.
- [ ] Documentation distinguishes implemented behavior from planned work.
